summary: Preserve the established mailbox stream recovery curve separately from connection-attempt backoff.

replay.detail: No mailbox fence, receipt, replay nonce or graph behavior changes.

schema.detail: No schema, indexes, persisted retry state or migration.

rules.detail: No authority, admission, lease duration or work predicate change.

downtime.detail: No coordinated stop or store conversion. Deployment is outside this patch.

manual.detail: No manual setup or repair is added.

compatibility.detail: A successful mailbox WebSocket HTTP101 upgrade selects the original fixed one-second jittered stream recovery cadence for later report-write/stream/EOF errors. Failed connect/handshake attempts retain exponential backoff and the refused-socket floor. Only a decoded application frame resets the open-failure count; an accepted upgrade does not.

recovery.detail: Three injected snapshot failures retain the existing six-second recovery oracle without a timeout change. A peer that repeatedly accepts and drops the stream is retried at the original fixed jittered one-second cadence indefinitely; the exponential policy does not protect that case. Reopen failures retain their previous count until a decoded frame.
